item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Rumor Reveals Which X-MEN Franchise Icon Is The Movie's "MVP"

item.description: Much has been said about the possibility of Wonder Man's Simon Williams being a mutant, and showrunner Andrew Guest has now addressed the possible X-Men link.

item.title: ETERNALS Director Chloé Zhao Explains Why Movie Simply "Wasn't High On [Marvel's] Priority List"
item.description: Chloé Zhao has spoken more about her experience working on Marvel's Eternals, explaining why the divisive superhero epic simply wasn't a high priority for the studio...

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Promo Art Reveals Doctor Doom, Magneto's Comic-Accurate Helmet, More
item.description: Official promo art for Avengers: Doomsday reveals a new look at almost the entire cast, including Robert Downey Jr.'s Doctor Doom, the Fantastic Four, and X-Men.

item.title: THE FANTASTIC FOUR: FIRST STEPS' Scrapped Steve Rogers Post-Credits Scene Reportedly Revealed
item.description: We finally have details on the scrapped post-credits scene for The Fantastic Four: First Steps featuring Chris Evans' Steve Rogers and Marvel's First Family.

item.title: FACES OF DEATH: Uncensored First Teaser For Horror Reboot Removed From YouTube For Violating Terms & Services
item.description: After six years on the shelf, a reboot of notorious video nasty Faces of Death is set for release this April, and a disturbing first teaser trailer is now online...

item.title: SEND HELP Ending Explained: What Happens To Linda And Bradley On The Island? - SPOILERS
item.description: Sam Raimi's twisted new horror movie Send Help finds a woman and her boss stranded on an uninhabited island. Here's how the movie ends and what their respective fates actually mean.

item.title: JOHN RAMBO First Look Revealed As Action Prequel Starring STREET FIGHTER's Noah Centineo Enters Production
item.description: Filming is now underway on Millennium Media's John Rambo, which will star Noah Centineo as a younger take on the legendary action hero made famous by Sylvester Stallone...

item.title: GOD OF WAR: Alastair Duncan Returning As Mimir As Prime Video Also Casts Sindri And Brok
item.description: The upcoming God of War TV series has added three more to its cast today, starting with Alastair Duncan, who reprises his role as Mimir from the God of War and God of War Ragnarök games.

item.title: FAST FOREVER: Vin Diesel Announces Release Date & Title For FAST & FURIOUS Finale
item.description: At long last, Vin Diesel has announced the release date for the eleventh film in his blockbuster Fast & Furious series, which will finally bring the family-oriented franchise to an epic close.
